intro: Twelve cities once gathered on this ground. You are at Panionium, a sanctuary in Aydın province from the 7th century BC. It was the common sanctuary of the twelve Ionian cities and the seat of their league, and Herodotus writes that resistance to Persia was debated here.
history: The common sanctuary of the twelve Ionian cities stood at the foot of Mount Mycale, and it was the meeting place of the Ionian League. Herodotus writes that what to do about Persia was debated here. And it was at these meetings that Thales proposed that the cities unite under a single government.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the sanctuary terrace and the altar, then the assembly steps, and the remains of the cult of Poseidon.
facts: Did you know? This was the common sanctuary of the twelve Ionian cities and the seat of their league. Yet Thales' proposal was rejected. The Ionian cities resisted separately, and were beaten one by one.
outro: This brings our journey through Panionium to an end. Before you go, please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Thank you for listening, and enjoy your visit.
